affected_subject.reason: Identifies FastAccessVault.rebalanceFunds() and related processTransfer/custodian operations.

trigger_or_action.reason: Concrete trigger: anyone calls rebalanceFunds() without access control, including after processTransfer and during external transfer to custodian.

direct_effect.reason: Immediate effects: unauthorized rebalancing/transfers, temporary under-collateralization causing redemption failures, and possible double-drain via reentrancy.

safety_relation_basis.reason: Derives authorization relation (no access control) and conservation/state relation (under-collateralization, double-drain of excess).

summary: Report identifies affected function, unauthorized trigger, concrete effects, and authorization/conservation safety relations sufficient to attempt formalization.
